notes: Professional 4-channel club DJ mixer (desktop/tabletop unit, not rack-mountable — rackUnits omitted). Port list compiled from Denon's official spec page (denondj.com) cross-referenced with the official X1850 Prime User Guide (cdn.inmusicbrands.com) rear/front panel descriptions. Master RCA and Record RCA outputs, and the 8 Phono/Line RCA input pairs, are each represented as one stereo L/R pair per logical port (consistent with how the manufacturer groups them) rather than as individual left/right jacks. "Digital In" (x4, one per channel) and "Digital Link In" (x1) are S/PDIF-style coaxial RCA; no version/rate grade is stated for these so grade is omitted (only Digital Out's format is specified as 24-bit/96kHz but that is not a connector "grade" tier in the given scale, so omitted per instructions). USB Port 1/2 connector type (USB-B) is inferred from industry-standard practice for this mixer class (matches sibling X1800 Prime and Pioneer DJM equivalents) — not explicitly confirmed in the sources fetched, so treat with medium confidence for that specific detail. Ethernet Link ports are proprietary "LAN hub" RJ45-style ports for StagelinQ/Denon media player networking (not general-purpose gigabit LAN) — no speed grade stated by manufacturer, so grade omitted. Send/Return (Receive) 1/4" TRS pair is an effects loop, not power.
